mapper.select: SELECT cr.* FROM ITN_CR cr JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_MAPPING reqMapping ON reqMapping.OBJECT_ID = cr.CR_NO AND reqMapping.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN DOCS_REQUEST req ON req.REQUEST_NO = reqMapping.REQUEST_NO JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_DETAIL currDetail ON currDetail.REQUEST_NO = req.REQUEST_NO AND currDetail.PROCESS_SEQ = req.CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO WHERE cr.CR_NO = #{crNo} AND cr.STATUS_CD = 20 AND req.REQUEST_TYPE = 'CR' AND req.STATUS_CD = 'REQUEST' AND req.CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO = 3 AND currDetail.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'ACCEPT' AND currDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} AND currDetail.ACTION_CD = 'REQUEST' LIMIT 1

SELECT req.REQUEST_NO FROM ITN_CR cr JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_MAPPING reqMapping ON reqMapping.OBJECT_ID = cr.CR_NO AND reqMapping.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN DOCS_REQUEST req ON req.REQUEST_NO = reqMapping.REQUEST_NO JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_DETAIL currDetail ON currDetail.REQUEST_NO = req.REQUEST_NO AND currDetail.PROCESS_SEQ = req.CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO WHERE cr.CR_NO = #{crNo} AND cr.STATUS_CD = 20 AND req.REQUEST_TYPE = 'CR' AND req.STATUS_CD = 'REQUEST' AND req.CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO = 3 AND currDetail.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'ACCEPT' AND currDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} AND currDetail.ACTION_CD = 'REQUEST' FOR UPDATE OF cr, req, currDetail
mapper.update: UPDATE DOCS_REQUEST_DETAIL currentDetail SET ACTION_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, REQUEST_DESC = #{requestDesc}, ACTION_CD = #{actionCd} WHERE currentDetail.REQUEST_NO IN ( SELECT req.REQUEST_NO FROM ITN_CR cr JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_MAPPING reqMapping ON reqMapping.OBJECT_ID = cr.CR_NO AND reqMapping.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN DOCS_REQUEST req ON req.REQUEST_NO = reqMapping.REQUEST_NO WHERE cr.CR_NO = #{crNo} AND cr.STATUS_CD = 20 AND req.REQUEST_TYPE = 'CR' AND req.STATUS_CD = 'REQUEST' AND req.CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO = 3 ) AND currentDetail.PROCESS_SEQ = 3 AND currentDetail.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'ACCEPT' AND currentDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} AND currentDetail.ACTION_CD = 'REQUEST'

UPDATE DOCS_REQUEST_DETAIL approvalDetail SET ACTION_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ORIGINAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.teamLeaderUid}, ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{approvalUser}, APPROVAL_GRADE_CD = 'TL' WHERE approvalDetail.REQUEST_NO IN ( SELECT req.REQUEST_NO FROM ITN_CR cr JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_MAPPING reqMapping ON reqMapping.OBJECT_ID = cr.CR_NO AND reqMapping.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN DOCS_REQUEST req ON req.REQUEST_NO = reqMapping.REQUEST_NO WHERE cr.CR_NO = #{crNo} AND cr.STATUS_CD = 20 AND req.REQUEST_TYPE = 'CR' AND req.STATUS_CD = 'REQUEST' AND req.CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO = 3 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_REQUEST_DETAIL completedDetail WHERE completedDetail.REQUEST_NO = req.REQUEST_NO AND completedDetail.PROCESS_SEQ = 3 AND completedDetail.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'ACCEPT' AND completedDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} AND completedDetail.ACTION_CD = 'ACCEPT' ) ) AND approvalDetail.PROCESS_SEQ = 4 AND approvalDetail.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'APPROVAL' AND approvalDetail.ACTION_CD = 'REQUEST' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_USER approver WHERE approver.USER_CD = #{approvalUser} AND approver.AUTH_APPROVAL_LEVEL = 2 AND approver.USE_YN = 'Y' AND approver.DEL_YN = 'N' AND approver.USER_CD != #{sessionUser.userCd} )

UPDATE DOCS_REQUEST request SET STATUS_CD = #{actionCd}, CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO = #{currentProcessSeqNo}, UPDATE_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATE_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} WHERE request.REQUEST_TYPE = 'CR' AND request.STATUS_CD = 'REQUEST' AND request.CURRENT_PROCESS_SEQ_NO = 3 AND request.REQUEST_NO IN ( SELECT reqMapping.REQUEST_NO FROM DOCS_REQUEST_MAPPING reqMapping JOIN ITN_CR cr ON cr.CR_NO = reqMapping.OBJECT_ID WHERE reqMapping.OBJECT_ID = #{crNo} AND reqMapping.USE_YN = 'Y' AND cr.STATUS_CD = 20 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_REQUEST_DETAIL completedDetail WHERE completedDetail.REQUEST_NO = request.REQUEST_NO AND completedDetail.PROCESS_SEQ = 3 AND completedDetail.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = 'ACCEPT' AND completedDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} AND completedDetail.ACTION_CD = #{actionCd} )
